subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about recovering abandoned-checkout and lapsed bookers for {Brand}. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to a validated completed booking with an itinerary ID and revenue, and net out cancellations and no-shows before we count it, the same recovery bar Skyscanner, Booking.com, and Tripadvisor work to. At that quality we recover roughly 1,500 completed bookings a day from search and checkout abandoners. If useful, I can pull the route-level recovery view for your live trips. Worth a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate validated completed-booking proof
illustrative_flags: 1,500 completed bookings a day recovered from search and checkout abandoners (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN travel_and_booking retargeting: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (validated completed booking, itinerary ID + revenue, net of cancellations) against the parent's Skyscanner/Booking.com/Tripadvisor recovery bar; one illustrative MobUpps figure (1,500 bookings/day); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native US English; no X-not-Y.
